# よね/Yone Website

> [よね/Yone Website](https://www.yoneyo.com/) is a website of "よね/Yone".

## About よね/Yone

- **Handle Name**: よね/Yone
- **English Handle Name**: Yone
- **Pronouns**: He/Him
- **Birthday**: November 30, 2006
- **Works**: Music Creator, App Developer
- **Location**: 日本、東京都立川市 (Tachikawa City, Tokyo, Japan)
- **Likes**: Watching Anime, Watching VTubers
- **Using Technology Stacks**:
    - Flutter
    - Next.js
    - React
    - .NET
    - ASP.NET Core
    - Node.js
    - Cloudflare Workers
    - Cloudflare Pages
    - etc.
- **Using Programming Languages**:
    - TypeScript
    - JavaScript
    - Dart
    - C#
    - Python3
    - HTML5/CSS3
    - etc.
